chunks: And indeed they are with Us among the chosen ones, the excellent.

key_terms.الْأَخْيَارِ: The best, the excellent, the virtuous
key_terms.الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ: The chosen ones, those selected by God

ai.seo_question: Who are the chosen ones mentioned in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as proof of the infallibility and superior spiritual rank of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly the Twelve Imams, who are viewed as the 'chosen ones' (al-mustafayn) selected by God for guidance. The term 'al-akhyar' (the best) underscores their moral and intellectual excellence, distinguishing them from the general prophets and establishing their unique authority in interpreting divine law.
